title: Cu–Al electrocatalysts for CO2 found with active learning
summary: DFT and active machine learning identified Cu–Al catalysts that reduce CO2 to ethylene with over 80% Faradaic efficiency at 400 mA/cm² (about 66% for pure copper) and 55% half-cell energy efficiency at 150 mA/cm². Synthesized and tested in the lab; the abstract does not state how many candidates were screened.

evidence.tested: Cu-Al catalysts synthesized and tested in the lab: over 80% Faradaic efficiency for ethylene at 400 mA/cm2 versus about 66% for copper, and 55% half-cell energy efficiency at 150 mA/cm2; in situ X-ray absorption examined the copper environment.
evidence.unknown: The abstract does not state how many candidates were screened or list explicit limitations; full text not read.
evidence.ai_role: DFT calculations combined with active machine learning identified the Cu-Al catalysts.
